title: "[VHH]-IMGT"
output: html_document
date: "2024-02-08"
---

Note: for [IgBLAST lastest releases](https://ftp.ncbi.nih.gov/blast/executables/igblast/release/LATEST/).

### Prep for IMGT

```
# Move to VHH directory
cd ~/VHH/data
# Copy over the file
cp *_atleast-1.fastq ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/
# Change the directory
cd ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1
```
### Convert the file to fasta

```{r, echo = T, eval = F}
# Directory
directory <- "~/VHH/data/"

# Arguments (List the _atleast-1 files)
args <- list.files(directory)[grepl("_atleast-1.fastq", list.files(directory))]
# args = commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

# Set current working directory to ncbi-igblast-1.17.1
setwd("~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1")

file_origin <- paste("~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/", args, sep = '')
file_output <- gsub(".fastq", ".fasta", file_origin)
results <- gsub(".fastq", '.fmt7', args)


for (i in 1:length(file_origin)){
  # load the fastq
  tmp <- ShortRead::readFastq(file_origin[i])

  # write as fasta
  ShortRead::writeFasta(tmp, file = file_output[i])
}

```

### IMGT

```{bash, eval = F}
bin/igblastn -germline_db_V database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_V -germline_db_D database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_D -germline_db_J database/alpaca_vhh_clean/alpaca_J -domain_system imgt -ig_seqtype Ig -organism alpaca -auxiliary_data optional_file/alpaca_gl.aux -outfmt '7 std qseq sseq btop' -query ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/S1-M02-TRIM_atleast-1.fasta -out ~/ncbi-igblast-1.17.1/S1-M02-TRIM_atleast-1.fmt7
```

```
# Copy back to data
cp S1-M02-TRIM_atleast-1.fmt7 ~/VHH/data
cp S1-M02-TRIM_atleast-1.fasta ~/VHH/data
```

### Make Database

```{bash, eval = F}
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0 \
  MakeDb.py igblast -i /data/S1-M02-TRIM_atleast-1.fmt7 -s /data/S1-M02-TRIM_atleast-1.fasta \
  -r /data/imgt-data/imgt_gapped_alpaca_IGHV.fasta \
  /data/imgt-data/imgt_gapped_alpaca_IGHD.fasta  \
  /data/imgt-data/imgt_gapped_alpaca_IGHJ.fasta \
  --outdir /data/ --failed --format airr --extended
```
